title: Regulatory Readiness Milestone Tracker — SOC2/ISO + SSO Audit Log Program
creator: Jordan Alvarez
description: This ticket consolidates milestone tracking and evidence owners for Redwood's SOC2 Type 1 path, ISO27001 scoping, SSO/SAML rollout, and enterprise audit-log guarantees. The goal is to create a living milestone tracker that bridges PM, Security, Engineering, and Compliance so we can present a single readiness view to Sales and Enterprise customers and meet gating criteria for Dedicated and Private deployments.
acceptance_criteria: Owner assigned and evidence checklist populated for each SOC2 CC control in scope
ISO27001 scope and Statement of Applicability drafted and linked to control owners
SSO/SAML rollout plan includes RBAC mappings, test matrix, and regression checklist
Audit log storage/retention policy documented and implementation tickets created with ETA
Executive readiness report (one-pager) produced and reviewed by Head of Security
Consolidated milestone dashboard created in Looker with per-milestone status and blockers
milestones: Milestone 1: SOC2 Type 1 evidence collection - complete evidence list + owners - target 2025-04-15 - Owner: Priya Nair
Milestone 2: SOC2 internal gap remediation plan - prioritized fixes for critical gaps - target 2025-04-30 - Owner: Alex Martinez (Security)
Milestone 3: ISO27001 scoping and SoA draft - target 2025-05-07 - Owner: Maya Gupta (GRC)
Milestone 4: SSO/SAML pilot with 3 enterprise customers - test matrix + automated regression - target 2025-04-22 - Owner: Marco Chen (Eng)
Milestone 5: Audit log retention & query SLA implementation (90-day hot, 2y cold) - target 2025-05-15 - Owner: ENG-3158
Milestone 6: Executive readiness report + sign-off - target 2025-05-23 - Owner: Jordan Alvarez
progress_updates: 2025-02-20: Kickoff meeting held with Security, Eng, and Legal. Agreed on SOC2 Type 1 as initial certification target; ISO scoping to run in parallel.
2025-02-28: Evidence matrix template created in Confluence and shared with control owners. Initial owners assigned for 60% of controls.
2025-03-03: Engineering estimates received for audit-log retention (ENG-3158). Proposed storage architecture: hot-tier on dedicated s3 + cold glacier with secure key access.
2025-03-05: Decision to decouple SSO pilot from full org RBAC rollout: pilot focuses on SAML assertion exchange and login flows; RBAC to follow once pilot passes.
2025-03-06: Looker dashboard skeleton created; data producers identified (Console, Runtime telemetry, Audit service).
decisions: Scope: SOC2 Type 1 first, Type 2 scheduled after evidence and remediation runway; ISO27001 to be scoped for 2025 Q3 if SOC2 path remains on track.
Audit log retention SLA: provide enterprise customers configurable retention with default 90-day hot storage; legal to review for regulated customers.
SSO pilot approach: run SAML 2.0 pilot with three existing customers using Dedicated instances before a global rollout to Hosted users.
Evidence collection method: prefer artifacts (logs, dashboards, PRs) linked in Confluence rather than snapshots where possible to keep living evidence.
blockers: ENG-3021: Runtime tagging for customer requests not yet finished; required for audit log linkage to customer account.
Legal needs template for Data Processing Addendum variations for EU customers; blocks final retention commitments.
One Security engineer on leave through 2025-03-20 slowing control remediations.
risks: Delay to ENG-3021 increases burden on manual evidence gathering and could push SOC2 Type 1 target by 2-3 sprints.
Scope creep: adding Type 2 or expanded ISO scope mid-cycle would dilute resources and delay all milestones.
Customer expectations: Sales requested firm date for certification; miscommunication could cause churn for large prospects.
